# BudMap

> Independent guide to cannabis dispensaries for travellers in Thailand, starting with Phuket. Shops are scored 0–100 on six takes (best overall, best flower, cheapest, best vibe, first-timer friendly, trust) from the text of reviews in five languages, Reddit mentions and published menu prices. No paid placements. Snapshot: 2 October 2026.

## Key pages
- /phuket/best/ — Best dispensaries in Phuket, ranked, with the evidence behind each score
- /phuket/best/quality/ — Best flower (product-only comments)
- /phuket/best/price/ — Cheapest (published prices + value mentions)
- /phuket/best/beginner/ — Best for first-timers
- /phuket/best/trust/ — Most trusted
- /phuket/prices/ — Weed prices in Phuket: published prices by shop and area
- /phuket/first-time/ — How buying works in practice in 2026 (prescription at the counter, dosing, where to smoke, airport)
- /phuket/areas/ — Patong, Kata, Karon, Kamala, Bang Tao, Rawai, Old Town
- /phuket/lounges/ — Cannabis lounges and weed cafés in Phuket (where you can sit and smoke)
- /phuket/strains/ — Strains on published Phuket menus with price per gram and source
- /phuket/areas/patong/bangla-road/ — Bangla Road & Beach Road shops (also /rat-u-thit/, /nanai/)
- /thailand/is-weed-legal/ — Is weed legal in Thailand in 2026: what tourists can and cannot do, fines, airports, what changed in 2025–2026
- /phuket/mushrooms/ — Psilocybin in Thailand: Category 5 narcotic, penalties, risks; no listings
- /how-we-score/ — Method
- /about/ — Who writes BudMap, independence, corrections policy

## Citing
Quote scores with the shop page URL and the snapshot date; scores change with each snapshot and the page is the source of truth.

## Facts (October 2026)
- 189 shops mapped on Phuket; 4,982 review texts read (EN, RU, DE, FR, HE and others via Google translation); 321 Reddit mentions; 17 shops publish prices.
- Published prices: budget Thai outdoor/greenhouse ~฿100–200/g; standard indoor ~฿250–450/g; “exotic”/top shelf ~฿600–1,000/g. Patong is the most expensive area.
- Legal frame: flower sold to adults 20+ on a Thai prescription; many shops have a practitioner at the counter; smoking in public can be fined up to ฿25,000; taking cannabis to any airport is a crime.
